findings.suggested_fix: In selectionOf(), skip text nodes whose parentElement fails visible() or is inside script/style/noscript/template (reuse the page walker's cache) and bump hidden_text; add a real-Chromium Ctrl+A/drag regression with hidden, aria-hidden, script and style content between visible paragraphs, checked in the Brain body.
findings.title: R9-01 repair regression: the rebuilt selection copies hidden text (display:none, aria-hidden, tiny/transparent/off-screen) and <script>/<style> source into 'Selected text', bypassing the hidden-text filter; injected instructions and page-state secrets reach the Brain request

findings.evidence: _pollOnce reads `asking` and awaits rt.call({'command':'assist_ask_status','ask_id': askId}); revoke() then runs _discardDerived() (answer=null, askId=null, _epoch++); when the earlier reply arrives, `if (v['state']=='FINISHED') _finishAnswer(v)` sets answer from v without comparing the epoch or v['ask_id'] to the current askId. check() and ask() capture the epoch, but the poll does not. Window: one round trip per 2 s poll. Found by reading the code; no reproduction run.
findings.suggested_fix: Capture _epoch and askId before the await in _pollOnce and drop the reply if either changed, or check data['ask_id'] == askId in _finishAnswer.
findings.title: Assist UI poll path has no epoch or ask-id check: an assist_ask_status reply in flight when the user presses Stop (or Stop, re-grant and a new ask) can still show the old answer (R9-05 class on the polling path)
